items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects nine equivalent conditions on the spectrum of a ring, mixing topological ones (profinite, Hausdorff, totally disconnected) with order-theoretic ones on the primes (statement lines 4975-4990). The proof groups the conditions by translating between quasi-compact opens and standard opens, uses the cited lemma for the implication from minimality of primes to closedness of standard opens, and then closes the chain to the topological conditions, with a second proof reducing the topological part to a result of the Topology chapter (proof lines 4992-5019). Keeping track of which translation connects which pair of conditions is the content. H2.
